lines.en: White bones tread the water, silent.
I stand as tall as a two-and-a-half door.
My joints click as I move.
The tide of the Silent Valley pushes me.
Seawater fills my frame.

lines.zh: 二十四点护甲，全是骨头
lines.en: Twenty-four points of armor, all bone.
I walk the seabed without a splash.
Long bones cover ground fast.
Seaweed hangs from my ribs.

lines.zh: 黑白骨色，远远就看得到
lines.en: Black-white bone is visible far off.
I patrol these shallows.
Waves hit; I don't sway.
Bone hands hanging, ready to rise.
No voice in my throat.
My prints stay in the sand.
Silent Valley guards walk like tides.
Standing still counts as guarding.
I listen to something deeper.
No breath, no heartbeat.
Salt crusts my bones.
My skull turns to the sea.
The tide rises and falls.
I've stood like this for many years.
Something swims out there.
I need no sleep.
Seaborn things don't rot.
Wind passes through my ribs.
Tiny shells stick between my bones.
I remember I wasn't a man.
A guard's job is waiting.
A living scent, quite clear.

lines.zh: 你在我二十七格的视野里
lines.en: You're within my twenty-seven blocks.
You're much shorter than my legs.

lines.zh: 我这双空眼窝，一直对着你
lines.en: These empty sockets stay fixed on you.
You're staring at my bones.
I keep this shore.
I hear you breathing.
Don't assume a skeleton walks slowly.
If I raise a hand, you should step back.
I don't know you, but I've noted you.
One of my bones has cracked.

lines.zh: 这一下打掉我几根肋骨
lines.en: That knocked a few ribs loose.
I've no flesh to bleed.
My joints are out of line.
I stepped back, splashing.
This damage won't stop the guard.

lines.zh: 我听见自己发出的响声
lines.en: I hear the noise I made.
Even bones need mending.
A precise hit; I'll remember.
Sea salt will fill the cracks.
I can't eat, and needn't.

lines.zh: 活人的食物，对我们无用
lines.en: Living food is useless to us.
Who is that held up for?
Bones need no feeding.
All I smell is seawater.
Take it away; don't wave it here.
Seaborn devour, but not this way.
You're testing me.
That rots; I've seen it.

lines.zh: 对尸体来说，食物很可笑
lines.en: Food is a joke to a corpse.
You hit my ribs.
Bones are hard; you should know.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，水花都没起
lines.en: I stepped back without a splash.
Go around; my frame is tall.
You bounced yourself off.

lines.zh: 二十四点护甲，不是虚的
lines.en: Twenty-four armor isn't for show.
My bone hand touched you.
Keep clear of this frame of bones.

lines.zh: 踩水的声音，我听得清楚
lines.en: I hear your splashing clearly.
Bumping me is notifying me.
I'm a guard's bones.
Seaborn don't speak of this.
No flesh, no such urges.
Ask the living.
My duty is guarding, not company.
Only wind passes between these bones.
Don't ask a skeleton that.
I'm no longer that person.

lines.zh: 喑谷不需要多余的东西
lines.en: The Silent Valley needs nothing extra.
Go back to your post; I'll keep mine.
Something black is buried in the sand.
One grab of a bone hand and it's up.
Coal? I have a use.
This fragment is very old.
I pick it up and tuck it between my ribs.
I know seabed things best.
Even shells count as a find.
I pinch it up with a toe bone.
This goes to the guards.
Done picking; back to the patrol.
You've stepped into the Silent Valley.
My bone hand has risen.
Ranged first; one shot.
Fourteen points of damage, enough to pierce.
You've been marked.
Guards need no reason.

lines.zh: 海嗣的骨头也认得敌意
lines.en: Seaborn bone knows hostility too.
There's a light in my sockets.
Step back and you may stay standing.
I won't chase beyond these shallows.
I level a bone hand at you.

lines.zh: 二十七格内，你都在里面
lines.en: Within twenty-seven blocks, you're inside.
Seawater drains from my joints.
I don't breathe, so I'm steady.
Wherever you circle, my skull turns.
I know ranged distance well.
Bone fingers flexed, ready to release.
Your moves are predictable.
I wait for you to step into the shallows.
The tide is counting your time.
My bone hand chops down.
A ranged shot first.
I sweep with a long bone.
My skeleton's balance is steady.
This lands on your shoulder.
Bone on bone, a dull sound.
You've backed into the water.
Fourteen a hit isn't light.
My finger bones are long.
One more strike.
Seawater rises first.
A tall skeleton rises from the tide.
The Silent Valley guard is in place.
Water still drips from my joints.
I stand straight, over two blocks.
This shore is mine.
No orders; I wake on my own.
My name is in the sound of the tide.

lines.zh: 黑白骨色，在雾里很显眼
lines.en: Black-white bone stands out in the mist.
The guard has returned.

lines.zh: 火舌舔过，我的骨头焦了
lines.en: The flames lick over and scorch my bones.
Half my frame came apart.

lines.zh: 我早就在水里，可这水不对
lines.en: I'm already in water, but this water is wrong.
The blast rattled my bones.
An arrow lodged in my ribs.

lines.zh: 这术法让骨头自己发抖
lines.en: This spell makes my bones shiver.

lines.zh: 没有海嗣的补充，我在散架
lines.en: Without seaborn supply, I'm coming apart.

lines.zh: 雷穿过骨头，整具骨架都亮了
lines.en: Lightning ran through me; the whole frame lit up.
There's no seabed beneath me.
